focus: Returning to the dormitory, the Nameless One recovers from the strain of telekinetic exertion while the Five gather around him in unspoken alliance, and a distant ancient presence stirs in the deep places below.
cutscene purpose: Establish the emerging bond between Geralt and the Five and hint at the subterranean ancient presence.
Joints ground bone against bone where cartilage had already worn through.
They formed a loose circle, bodies turned inward, creating a barrier between this one who had shown power and the rest of the dormitory population.
Coming from somewhere deep below the dormitory, deeper than the mines, deeper than the complex itself.
The thought arrived fully formed, pushing up from layers of consciousness that existed below language.
Recognition of something that had been buried long before the Anunnaki came, something that slumbered in darkness waiting for...

The scarred one kept their hand on the Nameless One's shoulder, anchoring them to consciousness, to the present moment, to the fragile connection forming between damaged beings who had nothing except each other.
The Nameless One closed their eyes.
Let exhaustion pull them down into darkness that was slightly less absolute than before.
